title: Divine LLaMAs: Bias, Stereotypes, Stigmatization, and Emotion Representation of Religion in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning religious personas (ranging from devout to cultural across major religions) to LLMs and prompting them to attribute emotions to specific events from the ISEAR dataset, followed by analyzing the distribution of predicted emotions, stereotypes, and refusal rates.

Evaluating the generation of culturally specific emotion terms (e.g., kvetch, krodha, khushu) and comparing the nuanced versus stereotypical representation of Western/Abrahamic traditions against Eastern traditions using persona-based emotion attribution.
